title: How the FlexLine Returned-Payment Fee Is Figured
content:
**Desk ruling — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** The way the returned-payment fee is figured follows the amount and the code of the return being charged: when the amount returned is below 1000.00 USD and the return code is R01 or R09 (funds not available), the figured fee is 2.5% of the amount returned, rounded to the cent, but never more than the tier's returned-payment fee; when the amount returned is 1000.00 USD or more, the figured fee is the larger of the tier's returned-payment fee and 2.5% of the amount returned, rounded to the cent; any other fee-bearing return below 1000.00 USD is figured at the tier's returned-payment fee as a flat amount.

Each rounding to the cent takes an exact half cent to the even cent.

| Amount returned | Return code | Figured fee |
|---|---|---|
| below 1000.00 | R01 or R09 | smaller of 2.5% of the amount and the tier's fee |
| below 1000.00 | any other fee-bearing code | the tier's fee |
| 1000.00 or more | any fee-bearing code | larger of 2.5% of the amount and the tier's fee |

## Hypothetical cases (tier fee 15.00 USD)

- R01, 400.00 returned: 2.5% is 10.00, smaller than 15.00, so 10.00.
- R09, 760.00 returned: 2.5% is 19.00, so the smaller is 15.00.
- R02, 400.00 returned: 15.00.
- R03, 1400.00 returned: 2.5% is 35.00, larger than 15.00, so 35.00.
- R01, exactly 1000.00 returned: 2.5% is 25.00, so 25.00.
